report_name: Charles & Keith Confirms Cyberattack After Ransomware Listing

threat_actors.name: TheGentlemen
threat_actors.description: A Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) operation that employs a double-extortion model. The group listed Charles & Keith on its data leak site after a confirmed cyberattack affecting some of the company's servers.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: TheGentlemen ransomware group encrypted servers at Charles & Keith as part of a confirmed cyberattack.

malware.name: TheGentlemen Ransomware
malware.description: Ransomware used by TheGentlemen group to encrypt servers at Charles & Keith as part of a double-extortion attack.

identities.name: Charles & Keith Group
identities.description: A Singapore-based fashion retailer that was the victim of a cyberattack by TheGentlemen ransomware group, which affected some of its servers.

infrastructure.name: TheGentlemen Data Leak Site
infrastructure.description: The data leak site used by TheGentlemen ransomware group to list Charles & Keith as a victim and threaten the release of exfiltrated data.

indicators.name: TheGentlemen Ransomware File Artifacts

title: TheGentlemen Ransomware File Artifacts
id: 7c5a8d9e-1b2f-4c3d-8e9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files associated with TheGentlemen ransomware, such as ransom notes or files with the group's extension, based on hunting hints.
references:

tags:

level: high

    TargetFilename|endswith: '.[thegentlemen]'
  selection_name:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\read-me.txt'
  condition: 1 of them
